verdict.rationale: Quo's own docs confirm that calls can be recorded and come back transcribed and summarized. Call history and voicemail transcripts can be retrieved later with filters through its MCP integration. Nothing in the evidence addresses consent handling or jurisdiction-specific announcements, and retrieval is described for transcripts and call history rather than for the recordings themselves. Missing for 10: jurisdiction-aware recording consent (announcements or opt-in controls), documented search and playback of the recording audio, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, I can record calls with the consent handling my jurisdictions require and find the recordings later

citations.quote: Recorded calls come back transcribed and summarized, so no detail is missed and nobody has to take notes.
Retrieve call history and voicemail transcripts from your Quo number. Use filters to focus on what’s relevant.
